prompt: Print a receipt: one 'item: $X.XX' line per item using two-decimal formatting, followed by a 'total: $Y.YY' line summing all prices. Complete the printReceipt method.
explanation: An index-based loop walks two parallel arrays at once: items[i] pairs with prices[i]. The %.2f specifier formats a double with exactly two decimal places, rounding as needed -- which also hides tiny floating-point error such as 0.1 + 0.2 producing 0.30000000000000004. Accumulating the total inside the same loop means one pass over the data, and the total line prints after the loop ends.
hints: Loop with an index i from 0 to items.length - 1 so you can read items[i] and prices[i] together.
System.out.printf("%s: $%.2f%n", items[i], prices[i]) prints one receipt line; %.2f forces two decimals.
Keep a running double total inside the loop and print the "total: $..." line with the same %.2f formatting after the loop.
